component-metadata.description:
Normalization of intensity columns. It is possible to choose from several normalization methods (median, quantile, loessF). If you want to use data already normalized in DIA-NN (columns PG.Normalised and PG.MaxLFQ), select "no normalization".
If a dataset should be normalized "per partes", user can specify the groups of columns that should be normalized together under Experimental design. Design should be provided in format "A, A, B, B". The order of categories is kept as per their occurence in the design field.
